messages:
erin: Heads-up — we're seeing a p99 latency spike and increased 5xx rate in inference-router (us-east-1). I opened a quick patch PR that adds backpressure and a short circuit for overloaded connections: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4211. Can someone take a quick look and approve if it looks sane? Oncall already paged.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected: inference-router (us-east-1) latency anomaly. Alert routed to #eng-oncall and oncall pager.

matt: On call. Looking now, give me ~5. Do we have a rollback plan if this makes things worse? :eyes:

derin: (typo) erm, meant erin

deepa: I'll review the PR in ~10m. Do you have a short smoke-test plan we can run post-merge?

erin: TL;DR: canary deploy 5% traffic, smoke test is a single sample request plus token latency check. I added a smoke script in the PR at tools/smoke/inference_check.sh. Commands: ```bash
# apply canary
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-router router=registry.redwood/inference-router:latency-patch-1786001234
# run smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-us-east.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"quick test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' | jq '.latency'
```
Rollback PR also ready: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4212 (reverts the change).

ryan: Quick skim — main logic looks ok. Left 2 tiny comments about metric names and one nits about test coverage.

matt: If ryan's comments are minor, we can merge and watch. I'm happy to merge once deepa gives a thumbs.

deepa: Taking a closer look now. One request: please expose a labeled metric `router_backpressure_active` (boolean gauge) so we can graph it. If that's in, LGTM.

erin: Added metric and pushed a small commit, also updated the smoke script to assert metric emission. PTAL.

deepa: Verified the added metric in staging, tests pass. Approving now.

matt: Approving and will merge to trigger canary. Merging in 30s.

oncall-bot: Deploy started for inference-router@latency-patch-1786001234 — canary=5% traffic. Link: https://deploys.redwood/status/inf-router/1786001234

matt: Merged. Watching logs and Sentry.

erin: Thanks all. I'll monitor traces and have rollback PR on standby.

oncall-bot: Canary deploy healthy at 5% after 2m. No increase in errors.

matt: p99 back to baseline on the canary hosts. Gradually routing to 25% now.

oncall-bot: Deploy scaled to 25% -> 100% over 10m. Final status: success.

ryan: Nice, good catch and quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

deepa: Great work. Leaving a follow-up ticket to add an alert runbook for this class of backpressure issues.

erin: Filed TICKET-998: runbook for router backpressure (link in PR). Thanks everyone! :heart:
